item.title: Osaka Sightseeing: Top 20 Spots from Dotonbori to the Castle & Beyond
item.description: Osaka is Japan’s third-largest city and its most underrated — a place where the quality of the sightseeing is consistently higher than the tourist maps suggest. Beyond the Dotonbori canal and Osaka Castle, the city contains one of Japan’s oldest shrines (Sumiyoshi Taisha, predating Buddhism’s arrival in Japan), a genuinely remarkable retro district in Shinsekai, and a mid-century coffee shop neighbourhood in Nakazakicho that feels nothing like the Japan in guidebooks.
